adjustment_period_approved_check.name: adjustment_period_approved_check
adjustment_period_approved_check.value: ("adjustment_period"."approved_by" is null and "adjustment_period"."approved_at" is null) or ("adjustment_period"."approved_by" is not null and "adjustment_period"."approved_at" is not null)

app_user_identifier_check.name: app_user_identifier_check
app_user_identifier_check.value: "app_user"."username" is not null or "app_user"."email" is not null

channel_fee_rule_amount_kind_check.name: channel_fee_rule_amount_kind_check
channel_fee_rule_amount_kind_check.value:
case "channel_fee_rule"."fee_kind"
        when 'commission_pct' then "channel_fee_rule"."percentage_rate" is not null and "channel_fee_rule"."fixed_amount" is null
        when 'processing_pct' then "channel_fee_rule"."percentage_rate" is not null and "channel_fee_rule"."fixed_amount" is null
        when 'fixed_per_order' then "channel_fee_rule"."fixed_amount" is not null and "channel_fee_rule"."percentage_rate" is null
        when 'delivery_subsidy' then "channel_fee_rule"."fixed_amount" is not null and "channel_fee_rule"."percentage_rate" is null
        when 'discount_funding' then "channel_fee_rule"."fixed_amount" is not null and "channel_fee_rule"."percentage_rate" is null
        else false
      end

recipe_line_component_ref_check.name: recipe_line_component_ref_check
recipe_line_component_ref_check.value: ("recipe_line"."item_id" is not null)::int + ("recipe_line"."sub_recipe_id" is not null)::int = 1

recipe_version_approval_check.name: recipe_version_approval_check
recipe_version_approval_check.value: "recipe_version"."state" <> 'approved' or ("recipe_version"."approved_by" is not null and "recipe_version"."approved_at" is not null)

calculation_snapshot_source_check.name: calculation_snapshot_source_check
calculation_snapshot_source_check.value: ("calculation_snapshot"."cost_card_id" is not null)::int + ("calculation_snapshot"."price_scenario_id" is not null)::int = 1

cost_card_approval_check.name: cost_card_approval_check
cost_card_approval_check.value: "cost_card"."state" <> 'approved' or ("cost_card"."approved_by" is not null and "cost_card"."approved_at" is not null)

goods_receipt_supplier_or_store_check.name: goods_receipt_supplier_or_store_check
goods_receipt_supplier_or_store_check.value: "goods_receipt"."supplier_id" is not null or ("goods_receipt"."store_name" is not null and btrim("goods_receipt"."store_name") <> '')

goods_receipt_accepted_check.name: goods_receipt_accepted_check
goods_receipt_accepted_check.value: "goods_receipt"."status" <> 'accepted' or ("goods_receipt"."accepted_by" is not null and "goods_receipt"."accepted_at" is not null)

stock_count_approved_check.name: stock_count_approved_check
stock_count_approved_check.value: "stock_count"."status" <> 'approved' or ("stock_count"."approved_by" is not null and "stock_count"."approved_at" is not null)

stock_transfer_dispatched_check.name: stock_transfer_dispatched_check
stock_transfer_dispatched_check.value: "stock_transfer"."status" not in ('dispatched', 'received') or "stock_transfer"."dispatched_at" is not null

stock_transfer_received_check.name: stock_transfer_received_check
stock_transfer_received_check.value: "stock_transfer"."status" <> 'received' or ("stock_transfer"."dispatched_at" is not null and "stock_transfer"."received_at" is not null)

waste_event_item_or_variant_check.name: waste_event_item_or_variant_check
waste_event_item_or_variant_check.value: "waste_event"."item_id" is not null or "waste_event"."product_variant_id" is not null

production_batch_actual_range_check.name: production_batch_actual_range_check
production_batch_actual_range_check.value: "production_batch"."actual_finish" is null or "production_batch"."actual_start" is null or "production_batch"."actual_finish" >= "production_batch"."actual_start"

approval_decided_check.name: approval_decided_check
approval_decided_check.value: ("approval"."decided_by" is null and "approval"."decided_at" is null and "approval"."decision" is null) or ("approval"."decided_by" is not null and "approval"."decided_at" is not null and "approval"."decision" is not null)

shift_actual_range_check.name: shift_actual_range_check
shift_actual_range_check.value: "shift"."actual_end" is null or "shift"."actual_start" is null or "shift"."actual_end" > "shift"."actual_start"

shift_adjustment_approved_check.name: shift_adjustment_approved_check
shift_adjustment_approved_check.value: ("shift_adjustment"."approved_by" is null and "shift_adjustment"."approved_at" is null) or ("shift_adjustment"."approved_by" is not null and "shift_adjustment"."approved_at" is not null)

document_version_published_check.name: document_version_published_check
document_version_published_check.value: ("document_version"."published_at" is null and "document_version"."published_by" is null) or ("document_version"."published_at" is not null and "document_version"."published_by" is not null)

period_close_granularity_check.name: period_close_granularity_check
period_close_granularity_check.value: ("period_close"."scope_type" = 'location' and "period_close"."period_start" = "period_close"."period_end") or ("period_close"."scope_type" = 'company' and "period_close"."period_start" = date_trunc('month', "period_close"."period_start")::date and "period_close"."period_end" = (date_trunc('month', "period_close"."period_start") + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date)

period_close_locked_check.name: period_close_locked_check
period_close_locked_check.value: ("period_close"."locked_by" is null and "period_close"."locked_at" is null) or ("period_close"."locked_by" is not null and "period_close"."locked_at" is not null)

period_close_reopened_check.name: period_close_reopened_check
period_close_reopened_check.value: "period_close"."status" <> 'reopened' or ("period_close"."reopened_by" is not null and "period_close"."reopened_at" is not null and "period_close"."reopen_reason" is not null)
